description_en: Updates the properties of a task
kebab_example: aliyun iacservice update-task-attribute --task-id task-4267dcfbf1b6dfff67fea425525e2 --auto-apply true --auto-destroy true --description this_is_description --group-info groupId=g-433aead7560571e66e31274ffd3 projectId=p-433aead75605713865c386cb9d --init-module-state false --module-version v1 --name TaskName --protection-strategy PreventDestroy --ram-role role --skip-property-validation false --terraform-version 1.5.7 --trigger-strategy Manual --client-token a65451293e64979ba7a4b573950217fe --tags tagValue=TestValue tagKey=TestKey --terraform-provider-version example-string --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTaskAttribute

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically execute the task. Default value: false.
- true: After the preview is complete (terraform plan), the execution (terraform apply) is automatically performed without manual confirmation.
- false: After the preview is complete (terraform plan), manual confirmation is required before the execution (terraform apply) starts
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动执行任务，默认值为false。
- true：指的是预览完成（terraform plan）后，无需人工二次确认，自动执行（terraform apply）。
- false：指的是预览完成（terraform plan）后，需人工二次确认并开始执行（terraform apply）
parameters.name: auto_apply

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically destroy resources after creation. Default value: false.
- true: After the execution is complete (terraform apply), the destroy operation (terraform destroy) is automatically performed without manual confirmation.
- false: After the execution is complete (terraform apply), no further action is taken
parameters.help_zh:
是否创建后删除，默认值为false。
- true：指的是执行完成（terraform apply）后，无需人工二次确认，自动执行销毁操作（terraform destroy）。
- false：指的是执行完成（terraform apply）后，无任何操作
parameters.name: auto_destroy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use a state file. Default value: false. This parameter is applicable when the template originates from resource export. Only one task can use this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用state文件，默认false，适用于模板为资源导出的来源，限制只能有一个任务使用
parameters.name: init_module_state

parameters.help_en:
The task name. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
- The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). It cannot start or end with a hyphen, underscore, or period.
- The name must be unique among all tasks under the current account
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称，需满足下述要求：

- 长度为 2~128 个字符。
- 允许大小写字母、数字、中文、短横线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.），且不能以短横线、下划线、半角句号开头或结尾。
- 名称在当前账号的任务资源下唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of resource protection strategies
parameters.name: protection_strategy

parameters.help_en: The RAM role. The system assumes this role to execute the template when a new job is triggered. This parameter is required when the job trigger method is not manual
parameters.help_zh:
RAM角色，
触发新作业时由系统扮演角色来执行模板，
作业触发方式非手动触发时必填
parameters.name: ram_role

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip enum value validation. Default value: false
parameters.name: skip_property_validation

parameters.help_en: The Terraform version. Call the **ListAvailableTerraformVersions** operation to obtain the list of supported versions. Default value: 1.5.7
parameters.help_zh: Terraform版本，通过 **ListAvailableTerraformVersions** API获取支持的版本列表，默认为1.5.7
parameters.name: terraform_version

parameters.help_en:
The job trigger method. Valid values:

- Manual: manually triggered (default).
- NewVersion: triggered when a new template version is published.
- ParameterSetUpdated: triggered when the parameter set content changes or the parameter set attach relationship changes.
- Auto: automatically triggered when the task's own properties change, such as task creation, execution version change, or job trigger policy change (when changed from another value to Auto).

The **ramRole** parameter is required when the trigger method is not manual
parameters.help_zh:
作业触发方式

- Manual  ：手动触发（默认）
- NewVersion ：模板发布新版本时触发
- ParameterSetUpdated 参数集自身参数内容变更或参数集绑定关系变更时       触发
- Auto ：当任务自身属性，如新建任务、执行版本或者作业触发策略（由其他改为Auto时），发生变更时自动触发

非手动触发时必填**ramRole**参数
parameters.name: trigger_strategy

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Format: [0-9a-zA-Z-]{1,64}. We recommend that you use a UUID
parameters.name: client_token

element_fields.help_en: The tag key of the task
element_fields.name: tag_key

element_fields.help_en: The tag value of the task
element_fields.name: tag_value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags for the task
parameters.name: tags
